verdict.rationale: Reducto publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json returns 200), and llms.txt indexes an API section. The docs also provide copy-paste code examples in Python, Node.js, Go and cURL, including a parse call against a hosted sample PDF. Studio lets users test workflows on real documents, but nothing shows the API reference itself is interactive with in-page runnable or 'try it' requests. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference/playground, in-browser runnable examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.
